notes:
• Each chat keeps what's typed in its message box, text and attachments, so leaving a chat and coming back finds it there. A message that fails to send also goes back into the box after you've left the chat, and on Android leaving the chat no longer cancels a message still being sent.
• Pocket Host's Notifications section only shows the registered phones and Send test now: the built-in key is the only one, the fields for your own APNs key are gone.
• iPhone: a sent message no longer sometimes stays in the message box after it has already shown up in the chat.
